title: Field connections.
officialText:
Field connections shall meet the requirements for corresponding types of shop connections
described in AISC 360. No holes, copes or cuts of any type shall be made to facilitate erection unless specifically shown on
the shop drawings or authorized in writing by the engineer or architect of record.
